chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Is'haq ibn Abd al-Aziz, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was asked about massaging with flour after the bath (noura), so he said: 'There is no problem.' I said: 'People allege that it is extravagance.' So he said: 'There is no extravagance in that which improves the body. Indeed, I sometimes order the pure [flour] to be mixed for me with oil, so I massage with it. The extravagance is only in that which consumes wealth and harms the body.'

key_terms.النُّورَة: The bath or bathing process (specifically in the context of the bathhouse)

ai.seo_question: Is using flour and oil for body massage considered wasteful in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) refutes the common misconception that using fine flour for body massage constitutes *israf* (extravagance), establishing a nuanced Shia legal principle where utility to the body negates waste. He distinguishes between mere expenditure and true waste by defining *israf* specifically as that which destroys wealth or harms the body, thereby validating personal grooming practices as beneficial rather than frivolous. This ruling reflects the broader Shia emphasis on balancing moderation with the preservation of health and dignity.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Usman Bin Isa, from Is’haq Bin Abdul Aziz who said,

‘Abu Abdullahasws was asked about the massaging with the flour (mixed with oil) after Al-Noura, so heasws said: ‘There is no problem’. I said, ‘They (people) are alleging that it is an extravagance’. So heasws said: ‘There is no extravagance in the correction (well-being) of the body. Sometimes I order with the pure (flour), so it is mixed for measws with the oil, so I massage with it. But rather, the extravagance is in what is destruction of the wealth and harmful for the body’.
en.sarwar: 13. In another Hadith it is narrated from ‘Abd al-Rahman who has said the following: “I once saw abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, rubbing with flour mixed with oil and I said that people dislike it.
He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful.’”
